notes: Release candidate for version 1.0.
Maintenance release.
Settings are read more carefully: a setting saved by another version can no longer stop CJ Radio starting.
If it ever hits an error it can't recover from, it says what went wrong and saves a short report.
Fixed: CJ Radio could close as soon as it started when CJ Philip Community had saved its theme setting. It now reads that setting either way.
CJ Radio is installed, updated and opened from CJ Philip Community, and no longer adds its own Start menu shortcut.

Maintenance release alongside the Writing Studio's typesetting.
Every programme from the calendar is listed as CJ Philip's; a guest can be named in the event's description (Guest: Name).
Wording throughout: CJ Radio is CJ Philip's own station.
Maintenance release alongside the new CJ Philip Community.
No scroll bars: the faint bar that showed while scrolling is gone too.
Maintenance release alongside the Writing Studio's Word import.
Pause: recordings pause and resume where you left off; the live show resumes at the live point; the same button pauses the Twitch player. Stop has its own button.
The ON AIR light glows gently while the show is live.
Smoother animations: eased page changes, status messages that fade in and out, and softer hover effects.
The schedule comes from the CJ Radio Google Calendar, including repeating shows, moved and cancelled episodes, and the clock changes; it works offline from the last copy.
Add to my calendar link on the Schedule page.
Recordings come from The CJ Philip Show repository on GitHub (files and releases), with an offline copy.
Subtle animations, and hidden scroll bars.
Now published by NorthRay Software; settings move to a NorthRay folder (copied, not removed).
Call-ins move to a Discord Stage; caller age 16 and over.
Sound only option using Twitch's Audio Only setting.
Shows the Twitch stream on the Listen page and goes on air when Twitch reports the channel is live.
Plays recordings from the app's Recordings folder.
